description: Default model order for free dispatch offloading (bin/free-agent-tool.py). The first AVAILABLE entry is used; a failed dispatch falls over to the next. Remote entries need ~/.api_keys/<provider>; local entries need their weights on disk. Override the whole list with config/dispatch-preferences.local.json (gitignored) or FA_DISPATCH_PREFS=<path>. Every entry needs family and roles (tests enforce it). An entry with smoke_tested=false is skipped until a smoke test passes, unless FA_DISPATCH_INCLUDE_UNTESTED=1. A request may name a "role" (operator, reasoner, validator, utility): only entries listing that role run, in this order. "avoid_family" skips a model family, so an adversarial review comes from a different family than the work it reviews: a different family often finds what a stronger same-family model misses. An optional "thinking": "on"|"off"|"auto" per entry (absent = auto) resolves the reasoning dial by role first (reasoner/validator dispatches think, operator/utility do not) and by model constraint last — GLM on NIM always thinks (OFF travels as reasoning_effort low), Nemotron's enable_thinking is not sendable statelessly (an OFF there is reported overridden). The resolution is reported in the result JSON as thinking / thinking_overridden / thinking_note.
maintainer_note: A-tier roster set by the free-agents maintainer, 2026-10-21; re-ordered 2026-10-31: Gemini 3.8 Flash stays FIRST for stateless DISPATCHES while its daily quota lasts (user 2026-10-31: superior and faster for that shape); Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk, NVIDIA) is SECOND for dispatches but FIRST for full sessions (pins + fallback chains; user top pick 2026-10-29). Then DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (NVIDIA), GLM 5.3 Flash, StepFun Step 5 Preview (user 2026-10-24: session-proven, 18 h zero errors), Nemotron 3 Ultra (fallback), then local DeepSeek V4 Flash, Laguna S, KAT Coder (fast, smaller: less sophisticated on hard tasks). Roles (maintainer-approved draft, 2026-10-21) say what each model is strong at; cross-family review is preferred over raw capability for adversarial checks. Kimi K3 was on the list but is NOT included: smoke-tested 2026-10-21, NVIDIA returns 410 Gone (end of life 2026-10-15) and Hugging Face, SiliconFlow, LLM7 and Kilo all answer 402 (paid credits required). GLM 5.3 full (z-ai/glm-5.3) was REMOVED 2026-10-31: NVIDIA retired it (410 Gone, end of life 2026-10-28T08:00:00Z; live catalog no longer lists it) — retired ids must never stay in this file or in fallback chains. The roster will change: add or remove entries here, keeping family and roles set.

order.note: Strong all-rounder; fast. Leads stateless dispatches while its daily quota lasts (user 2026-10-31: superior and faster for that shape); free quota runs out fast in a full session, so use it for dispatch.

TOP PICK for full SESSIONS (user 2026-10-29): 1.05T total / 52B active granular MoE, multimodal, 1M context, NVFP4 on NIM; faster and more responsive than GLM Flash in full sessions (user 2026-10-31). Second for dispatches (after Gemini). Fills the gap left by GLM 5.3 full (NVIDIA 410 EOL 2026-10-28T08:00:00Z; removed from this file 2026-10-31).
Thorough analysis and review; slow per request (minutes), too slow for a full session.
Fast thinking model; the full-session workhorse.

Session-proven 2026-10-24: 18 h / 589 turns / zero API errors on the NVIDIA free lane (shipped cost-tracker 0.16.0-0.18.0); median turn 23 s. User 2026-10-24: one of the best models available on NVIDIA.
Fallback when the others are unavailable.
Private (never leaves the machine). Very slow in a full session; dispatch is more feasible.
Laguna S 2.1, local: stronger than Laguna XS. Private; strong coder. (NVIDIA's Laguna XS is local-capable and deliberately NOT on this roster: NVIDIA has stronger models.)
Private and very fast; smaller, so weaker on hard tasks: bulk and mechanical work.

session_fallbacks.description: Fallback chain for a FREE SESSION's proxy (bin/remote-session.sh), used when the session's own model is throttled upstream: the proxy answers from the next model here, same port, no restart. Same provider only (a session would drain another provider's free quota). The session's own model is skipped. LA_REMOTE_FALLBACKS=off disables; LA_REMOTE_FALLBACKS=provider:model,... overrides.
session_fallbacks.maintainer_note: Order set 2026-10-31: Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) first, then GLM 5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (slow but superior quality, so above Nemotron), Step 5 Preview, Nemotron 3 Ultra last (least capable, least likely to be throttled). z-ai/glm-5.3 removed — retired by NVIDIA (410 EOL 2026-10-28T08:00:00Z); a retired id must never be in a fallback chain.
